An important reminder about water bowls
It is for people travelling soon
Water bowls and travel plans

Travelers should check their pet setup before arriving at Aurelia Skyways. Bring the right carrier, make sure it is secure, and keep your animal comfortable from the start. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help you avoid last-minute stress and make the trip feel calmer for everyone.

If you are bringing a cat or reptile, please review the travel rules before you pack. <<FACT F067>> Staff will look over your setup with care and help you spot anything that needs adjusting. <<FACT F078>> That way, you can arrive ready and keep the process smooth at the skyport.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for friendly help before you fly.
